reason: The official Ordnance Survey OS Open Linked Identifiers product is a materially different identifier-linkage method from the prior OS Open UPRN point dataset. It can authoritatively relate UPRNs to OS MasterMap TOIDs and other identifiers, including building-footprint relationships, but its official getting-started guide explicitly states that the CSV files contain no spatial information. It therefore cannot by itself supply a cadastral/title parcel polygon or canonical parcel bbox. No target-specific canonical parcel binding exists in the verified lineage, so accepted/materialized/direct parcel counts remain zero and spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
